title: One stacked-row layout
assertion: Each stacked row is a list item headed by its naming cell at the level the caller gives (a link when the row has one), then a definition list of each column's label and value, then the row's actions; expected, paid and short are given together and in that order, and the stacked rows keep the table's column order, each figure in the mono face with tabular numerals; a status wraps inside the card; the rows carry their own hooks, never the table's, and no id or hook repeats between the two copies; with a table, the table shows from the table's own width up and the rows below it, by a container query on a full-width wrapper
noFileReason: The stacked rows are rendered from synthetic rows the test passes in memory; no file.
